people.name: Jeroboam
people.line: First king of the northern kingdom of Israel.

translations.web: But Jeroboam caused an ambush to come about behind them; so they were before Judah, and the ambush was behind them.
translations.bsb: Now Jeroboam had sent troops around to ambush from the rear, so that while he was in front of Judah, the ambush was behind them.
translations.kjv: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
translations.asv: But Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind them: so they were before Judah, and the ambushment was behind them.
